title: Compliance Decision Table: Borrower-Requested Lock Extensions and Relocks in a Mortgage Loan File Zero-Tolerance Cure
content:
For the zero-tolerance cure on a Mortgage Loan File, lock costs the borrower asked for are taken out of the measured increase. The entries read are the pricing entries of every Rate Lock Commitment of the customer: borrower-borne extension entries, relock fee entries and the lock cost waivers Larkspur booked, with their booking dates and dollar amounts.

**Rule.** Where borrower-borne lock extension entries were booked on any rate lock of the customer less than 1 whole month before the cure date, the borrower requested that extension and its dollar cost, less any lock cost waivers Larkspur booked on the customer's locks in that period and never below zero, is taken out of the measured increase; where no such extension entry was booked in that period but relock fee entries were, those relock fees, less such waivers and never below zero, are taken out; where neither was booked in that period, nothing is taken out.

The cure date is the date the cure is assessed. An entry is booked less than 1 whole month before it where the cure date falls before the same day of the month following the entry's booking date.

| Borrower-borne extension entry in the period | Relock fee entry in the period | Taken out of the measured increase |
|---|---|---|
| yes | either | the total dollar cost of the borrower-borne extension entries, less the lock cost waivers booked in the period, never below zero |
| no | yes | the total of the relock fees, less the lock cost waivers booked in the period, never below zero |
| no | no | nothing |

## Worked case (hypothetical)

Measured increase 412.50 USD; a borrower-borne 15-day extension costing 412.50 USD was booked on the customer's Rate Lock Commitment 9 days before the cure date. 412.50 USD is taken out, leaving 0.00 USD. Had the only entry in the period been a relock fee of 300.00 USD, 300.00 USD would be taken out instead, leaving 112.50 USD. Had Larkspur also booked a lock cost waiver of 250.00 USD on the customer's lock in the period, the extension's 412.50 USD less 250.00 USD, which is 162.50 USD, would be taken out, leaving 250.00 USD.
